map.依据《劳动合同法》计算经济补偿金（N）、代通知金、违法解除赔偿金（2N）: Computes economic compensation (N), payment in lieu of notice and damages for unlawful termination (2N) under the Labor Contract Law
map.📖 查看「劳动争议赔偿估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Labor Dispute Compensation Estimate User Guide"
map.劳动争议赔偿 = 工资×年限×系数: Labor dispute compensation = wage × years × multiplier
map.当地上年度职工月平均工资3倍（元，用于封顶）: Three times the local average monthly wage of the previous year (¥, used as the cap)
map.解除/终止劳动合同情形: Ground for termination of the labor contract
map.协商解除（用人单位提出）: Termination by agreement (proposed by the employer)
map.无过失性辞退（医疗期满/不胜任/客观情况变化）: No-fault dismissal (end of medical period / incompetence / changed circumstances)
map.经济补偿 N + 代通知金 1个月: Economic compensation N + 1 month in lieu of notice
map.劳动者主动辞职 / 用人单位过失性辞退（39条）: Employee resigns / fault-based dismissal by the employer (Article 39)
map.判断解除/终止劳动合同属于哪种情形，对应经济补偿 N、代通知金或赔偿金 2N。: Identify which ground of termination applies, and match it to economic compensation N, payment in lieu of notice, or damages of 2N.
map.违法解除且劳动者不要求继续履行的，按经济补偿标准二倍支付赔偿金。: For unlawful termination where the employee does not seek reinstatement, damages equal twice the economic compensation.
map.月工资超社平 3 倍的，基数封顶且年限最高 12 年。: Where the monthly wage exceeds three times the local average, the base is capped and the years counted are limited to 12.
map.工作 5 年、月薪 1.2 万、违法解除：赔偿金 = 12000 × 5 × 2: Five years of service, monthly salary ¥12,000, unlawful termination: damages = 12000 × 5 × 2 = ¥120,000.
map.用人单位提出协商解除，工作 8 年、月薪 1 万：经济补偿 = 10000 ×: Where the employer proposes termination by agreement with 8 years of service and a monthly salary of ¥10,000: compensation = 10000 × 8 = ¥80,000, with no 2N and no payment in lieu of notice.
map.解除劳动关系取得的一次性补偿收入，在当地上年职工平均工资 3 倍数额以内的部分免: Of a one-off compensation payment on termination of employment, the part within three times the local average annual wage of the previous year is exempt from individual income tax; the excess is taxed separately under the comprehensive income rate table.
map.一般主动辞职无补偿；但因单位欠薪、未缴社保等违法情形被迫辞职的，可主张经济补偿。: Voluntary resignation normally brings no compensation, but where the employee is forced out by unlawful conduct such as unpaid wages or unpaid social insurance, economic compensation may be claimed.
